law.name: trapped_own_heat_r12
law.description: round 25, registered (round25-trapped-suite.md): the self-energy repair's trapping on the round-12 law. Glow born where n < 0 (Q > a/4 + sqrt(a T)) is heard only where n < 0; unresolved galaxies at their SDSS sizes; a cluster galaxy's own glow at the heat of its internal motions (SDSS, 10^11.05); u refitted on X-COP
